raw_response: The company shows strong profitability (high gross and operating margins) but very weak liquidity (current ratio 0.34) and very high leverage ( liabilities nearly equal to assets with limited equity). This liquidity stress amid solid earnings suggests a non-investment-grade rating, likely BB- to reflect elevated default risk but not immediate distress. DECISION: BB-
